name: RescueTime
tagline: The core loop is small enough for a capable coding agent to produce a useful local version in one sitting. For RescueTime, measure opt-in application time, classify it, and run focused sessions locally. The hard boundary is cross-device history, website blocking, goals, reports, and long-term behavioral dataset, plus ubiquitous capture, coaching, and team workflow.
